candidates.name: tree-pop
candidates.legality: The private stack-pointer word has just been published. Loads into other registers cannot change it or its register copy.

candidates.name: tree-frame
candidates.legality: Each removed LEA repeats the current r10 value. Intervening stores read r10 as an address.

candidates.name: tree-bool
candidates.legality: Both sequences leave r11 and rdi equal to the nonzero predicate. The following XOR and TEST define live flags and overwrite r10.

candidates.name: bst-decrement
candidates.legality: LEA produces the same modular 64-bit decrement. SHR, AND and final CMP overwrite flags before use.

candidates.name: bst-literal
candidates.legality: A 32-bit register write zero extends exactly this unsigned literal; flags preserved.

candidates.name: bst-frame
candidates.legality: The two LEAs repeat the established address; the intervening loads write r13 and rdx only.

candidates.name: edit-increment
candidates.legality: The 32-bit modular index is zero extended. Both rsi and arithmetic flags are redefined before use.

candidates.name: edit-predicate
candidates.legality: The compared operands are zero-extended U32s (r8 came from MOVL). SETNE produces the same full-word boolean; scratch values and flags die locally.

candidates.name: edit-minima
candidates.legality: Select the same unsigned minima, including ties. Preserve frame stores; old scratch/copy values are overwritten before use.

candidates.name: ray-zero
candidates.legality: Converting integer zero produces exact positive float zero under all rounding modes. These assignments restore all live registers and SSE upper lanes.

candidates.name: ray-copies
candidates.legality: Eliminate register round trips. No intervening definition of each copied value reaches a use before the next write. Scalar evaluation order is preserved.

candidates.name: ray-memory
candidates.legality: Memory operands read the same valid 32-bit private stack slots. FP operation order and destination upper lanes are retained; xmm1 is overwritten before its next live read.

candidates.name: lexer-pop
candidates.legality: rdi already contains the just-stored private stack pointer.

candidates.name: lexer-captures
candidates.legality: Reuse the just-published SP across private frame spills. Neither state nor rdi is modified.

candidates.name: lexer-immediate
candidates.legality: ADD operates on identical bits and sets identical flags; the displaced r11 constant is overwritten in this block.
